title: Mystical Forest Spirit (Anime Fantasy)
description: Studio Ghibli-style mystical forest spirit character. Works for fantasy book covers, RPG character art, and ethereal social media content.

prompt.main: mystical forest spirit girl with long flowing silver hair, wearing a dress made of moss and wildflowers, gentle glowing antlers made of birch branches, surrounded by floating fireflies in an enchanted forest, studio ghibli atmosphere, hayao miyazaki style, soft pastel palette --ar 2:3 --niji 6 --s 850

explained.why: Niji 6 is MJ's anime model. Ghibli-style needs Niji.
High stylize for the soft painterly Ghibli feel.

tutorial.intro: Ghibli forest spirit = "moss dress" + "antlers made of branches" + "fireflies" + "Hayao Miyazaki". Skip any one and it goes generic fantasy.
steps: Subject: mystical forest spirit girl with long flowing silver hair 鈥?spirit + character details.
Outfit: dress made of moss and wildflowers 鈥?nature-as-clothing is the Ghibli signature.
Signature: gentle glowing antlers made of birch branches 鈥?antlers = forest spirit visual cue.
Atmosphere: surrounded by floating fireflies in an enchanted forest 鈥?fireflies = magic.
Reference: studio ghibli atmosphere, hayao miyazaki style 鈥?name the studio + director.
tutorial.tips: Niji 6 + "hayao miyazaki" is the magic combo for Ghibli aesthetic. Without Niji, MJ defaults to realistic.

faq.q: Why does my spirit look like a generic elf?
faq.a: You forgot "antlers made of branches" + "moss dress". These transform an elf into a forest spirit.

faq.q: How to get true Ghibli feel?
faq.a: Use --niji 6 + name "hayao miyazaki" + specify "soft pastel palette". Without Niji, you get photorealistic.
2:3 vertical ratio + character + atmospheric background. Vertical sells the "cover art" feel.
